bio.text: Buddy Carter represents Georgia's 1st Congressional District in the U.S. House, where his office says he is serving his sixth term, and sits on the Energy and Commerce and Budget committees.
He owned Carter's Pharmacy for over 32 years, and previously served as Mayor of Pooler, Georgia, and in the Georgia General Assembly.
He was born and raised in Port Wentworth, Georgia, and earned a pharmacy degree at the University of Georgia after attending Young Harris College.
